}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview==
"Luckfox Lyra Pi" and ''LuckFox'' logo are silkscreened on board top. {{See also|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3506B @1.5GHz Tri-Core ARM (Cortex-A7), :1x ARM Cortex-M0 core *Storage: TF card (max.256GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 512MB (DDR3L) RAM *Wi-Fi: [[AIC]] AIC8800 DC (2.4GHz 1T1R 802.11ax) :AX300; SDIO: Wi-Fi, UART/PCM: BT 5.2 BLE *Network: 2x Fast Ethernet (100M) port *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) OTG, 2x USB 2.0 (Host) ports, :1x M.2 for slot for 4G module *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port :or 802.3af via optional PoE Hat
==Links of Interest== * [https://wiki.luckfox.com/Luckfox-Lyra-Pi Documentation] *[https://linuxgizmos.com/luckfox-lyra-pi-with-core3506-soc-provides-optional-4g-and-poe-in-a-raspberry-pi-sized-form-factor/ ''Luckfox Lyra Pi with Core3506 SoC'' on '''LinuxGizmos'''] *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2025/07/22/luckfox-lyra-pi-a-raspberry-pi-like-sbc-with-rockchip-rk3506b-triple-core-soc/ ''Luckfox Lyra Pi – A Raspberry Pi-like SBC with Rockchip RK3506B'' on '''CNX-Software''']
